items.verified_construct: Asciminib inhibits BCR::ABL1 by binding the ABL myristoyl pocket, supporting allosteric rather than ATP-site inhibition.
items.second_answer_attack: ATP-site competition is plausible for other ABL inhibitors, but the structural clue explicitly places drug occupancy outside the ATP-binding site.

items.verified_construct: Pirtobrutinib is a noncovalent BTK inhibitor that binds wild-type BTK and BTK harboring C481 mutations.
items.second_answer_attack: A covalent C481-dependent mechanism is excluded both by the C481S substitution and by the stipulated absence of a covalent drug-protein adduct.

items.verified_construct: Adagrasib irreversibly and covalently binds KRAS G12C and locks the mutant protein in an inactive state, reducing downstream signaling.
items.second_answer_attack: Options that increase active-state occupancy or effector association predict the opposite signaling direction; gene correction is not required.

items.verified_construct: Luspatercept binds several endogenous TGF-beta superfamily ligands, diminishes Smad2/3 signaling, and promotes erythroid maturation.
items.second_answer_attack: Direct erythropoietin-receptor agonism is explicitly excluded by the separate receptor assay and does not match the ligand-trap mechanism.

items.verified_construct: Avapritinib directly inhibits KIT D816V kinase activity and autophosphorylation.
items.second_answer_attack: Stem cell factor neutralization cannot explain inhibition in a ligand-free assay with constitutively active KIT D816V.

items.verified_construct: Teclistamab is a bispecific T-cell engager binding CD3 on T cells and BCMA on multiple-myeloma cells.
items.second_answer_attack: BCMA plus CD28 is a plausible engineered immunotherapy pairing but is not teclistamab's documented bispecific target pair; CD3-BCMA is unique.

items.verified_construct: Faricimab is a bispecific antibody that binds VEGF-A and angiopoietin-2.
items.second_answer_attack: VEGFR2/Tie2 would be receptor-directed blockade, whereas the stem stipulates direct binding of two soluble ligands.

items.verified_construct: Iptacopan binds factor B in the alternative complement pathway, regulating C3 cleavage, downstream effectors and terminal-pathway amplification; in PNH it controls both C3b-mediated EVH and terminal-complement-mediated IVH.
items.second_answer_attack: Isolated terminal-complement blockade can preserve proximal C3b opsonization, but factor B inhibition is proximal and therefore supports decreases in both readouts.

items.verified_construct: Sutimlimab specifically binds C1s, blocks classical-pathway C4 cleavage, and does not inhibit lectin or alternative complement pathways.

items.second_answer_attack: C5 and C3 are downstream/shared complement components; factor B belongs to the alternative pathway and MASP-2 to the lectin pathway. Preserved lectin and alternative activity with impaired classical C4 cleavage uniquely localizes C1s.
